first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-specific DTM tile filenames and the official CRS for the historic Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official SpatialNI/LPS Enhanced Digital Terrain Model guide window is readable and explicitly documents the current OSNI Enhanced DTM as DXF, 291 full sheets, 9.6 x 6.4 km tile size, full Northern Ireland coverage and Coordinate Reference System TM75 Irish National Grid. However, the guide describes the current Enhanced DTM product and does not state that the historic Belfast City 2006 River Basin LiDAR ASCII-grid archive uses the same CRS, sheet scheme or filenames; TM75 and the 9.6 x 6.4 km sheet scheme are therefore not transferred to the 2006 archive, and no historic tile filename, CRS or parcel binding is fabricated.
